summary_en: On November 6, 2026, IMURA will execute a block purchase of up to 70,000 shares (0.70% of outstanding shares excluding treasury stock) at the closing price of 880 yen per share on November 5, 2026, for a maximum total of 61.6 million yen, via ToSTNeT-3 off-hours trading. This execution is part of a 100,000-share buyback program (up to 1 billion yen) approved by the Board on September 14, 2026, with a purchase period through January 29, 2027.
title_en: Notice Regarding Purchase of Treasury Shares via Off-hours Trading at Tokyo Stock Exchange (ToSTNeT-3)
translation_en_brief:
IMURA announced on November 5, 2026, that it will execute a block purchase of treasury shares on November 6, 2026. The company will place a buy order in the off-hours trading session (ToSTNeT-3) at the Tokyo Stock Exchange at 8:45 a.m. The purchase will be conducted at the closing price of 880 yen per share on November 5, 2026. The company will acquire up to 70,000 shares, representing approximately 0.70% of outstanding shares excluding treasury stock as of September 30, 2026 (10,021,165 shares), for a maximum total expenditure of 61.6 million yen.

This execution is part of a broader buyback program authorized by the Board of Directors on September 14, 2026. Under that authorization, the company is permitted to acquire up to 100,000 shares (0.99% of outstanding shares) for a maximum total of 1 billion yen during the period from September 15, 2026, through January 29, 2027. The November 6 execution represents a partial draw-down from this authorized program. The company will announce results after the trading session concludes; acquisition of some or all of the shares may not occur depending on market conditions.
